visual.material: grassy soil with a low rise
visual.art_notes:
Grass-topped ground that rises gently in the middle, 2 tiles tall
at the peak and 1 tile tall at the edges. Reads as a small
natural mound. Use for breaking up long flat stretches; the
player can walk over it without jumping. Grass blades on top,
dirt body below — same palette as `ground`.
